meta.method: Manual topic/aspect review of independently authored evidence. Sources are grouped by publisher, syndicated copies count once, and amenities are separated from subjective impressions. Labels describe supported amenities and land uses, not residents, safety, noise measurements or a sentiment score. Editorial anchors identify a corridor or area without claiming precise boundaries. No model calls occur at runtime. Broad labels summarise the same reviewed area at wider zoom; district labels add specificity.
